settings.title: Preferences & Settings
settings.showPaidProvidersDesc: Display commercial cloud providers requiring paid API keys (such as OpenAI Whisper, Google Cloud Translation, and DeepL). When disabled, only free and local offline providers are shown.
settings.hideOnCaptureDesc: Automatically hide overlay and result panel while selecting capture area, and restore when finished
settings.openLogsDesc: Inspect persistent log files (app.log, error.log) recorded by Winston.
settings.closeBehaviorDesc: Choose whether closing the window minimizes EchoLingo to the system tray or exits completely.
settings.minimizeToTrayDesc: Stays running in background for hotkeys and overlay.
settings.enableSplashScreenDesc: Display animated glass splash screen while initializing core services.
settings.quitAppDesc: Completely terminates app and background tasks.
settings.askEveryTimeDesc: Prompts with dialog options before closing.
settings.trayHint: When running in the system tray, right-click the EchoLingo icon in your taskbar to start/stop live subtitles, toggle floating overlay, capture & translate screen, or quit the app.

exitModal.title: Closing EchoLingo
exitModal.desc: Choose what happens when you close the application:
exitModal.minimizeDesc: Keeps EchoLingo active in your notification area. Global shortcuts and subtitle overlay stay available.
exitModal.quitDesc: Stop all active sessions, speech recognition, and close all windows.
exitModal.rememberChoice: Remember my choice (You can change this anytime in Settings)

interactiveTour.title: Interactive App Instructions & Tour
interactiveTour.desc: Replay the step-by-step walkthrough covering audio sources, live subtitles, screen OCR, and global hotkeys.

0.title: Welcome to EchoLingo
0.tagline: Offline-first real-time speech recognition, live subtitling, and AI translation pipeline.
0.pillar1Desc: Whisper local models and Windows SAPI run strictly on your machine. Zero telemetry, no silent uploads.
0.pillar2Desc: Continuous VAD audio processing decoupled from the 60fps glassmorphism UI thread.
0.pillar3Desc: Type-safe IPC architecture with Zod schema validation across all process boundaries.

1.title: Choose the Right Audio Source
1.tagline: Crucial: Decide whether you want to transcribe your voice or PC sound.
1.systemDesc: Captures internal PC sound directly from browsers, media players, and conferencing apps without room echo.
1.micDesc: Captures your physical microphone when you are speaking or presenting.

2.title: Live Subtitles & Floating Overlay
2.tagline: Display transparent, non-intrusive subtitles on top of any active window or video stream.
2.overlayDesc: Always-on-top glass window that sits above videos, streams, and games. Supports click-through mode so it never interrupts your clicks.
2.sampleOriginal: EchoLingo streams real-time subtitles with microsecond latency.
2.sampleTranslation: EchoLingo phát phụ đề thời gian thực với độ trễ cực thấp.

3.title: Instant Screen Translation & OCR
3.tagline: Translate text anywhere on your screen by simply dragging a selection box.
3.hotkeyDesc: Freezes your screen into an interactive canvas. Drag over untranslated manga, comics, software UI, or games to translate instantly.
3.continuousDesc: Automatically re-translates a fixed screen region as subtitle lines or dialogues update, with built-in Levenshtein deduplication.

4.title: Video Subtitles Studio
4.tagline: Transcribe, translate, edit, and burn-in subtitles for local video files.
4.featureDesc: Drag & drop MP4, MKV, or WEBM files. Generate synchronized cues, edit text inline, and export to SRT, VTT, or ASS files.

5.title: Essential Shortcuts & You're Ready!
5.tagline: Master these global hotkeys to control EchoLingo seamlessly from anywhere.
5.searchHint: Press Ctrl+K or Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to open the global command palette.
5.settingsHint: You can revisit this interactive tour anytime in Settings > Interactive App Instructions.

video.title: Video Subtitle Studio
video.subtitle: Transcribe, translate, customize visual styles, and burn subtitles directly onto video frames.

dropzone.title: Choose a video or drag it here
dropzone.subtitle: Supports MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM, AVI. Subtitle text will be placed directly in the video.

export.description: This will permanently burn your styled subtitles into the video frames using FFmpeg. The output video can be played on any player or shared to social media with subtitles visible.
export.modeBurnInDesc: Permanently burn styled subtitles into video frames using FFmpeg. Playable on any device.
export.modeFileDesc: Export subtitles as standard files for VLC, media players, or video editors.
export.noCuesWarning: No subtitle cues found in this video. Please auto-transcribe or add cues before exporting.

ffmpegMissing.title: FFmpeg Not Detected
ffmpegMissing.desc: Video audio extraction and subtitle burn-in require FFmpeg. Click Auto-Install to download and configure it to your PATH automatically.

video.noAudioTooltip: This video does not contain an audio track to transcribe.
video.noAudioHint: This video does not have an audio track. You can add subtitles manually using "Add Cue Here" or import an existing .SRT / .VTT file.
video.autoTranscribeTooltip: Extract audio and auto-transcribe with Whisper
